messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up: Sana Malik is joining Redwood Inference as Head of Model Ops starting June 2. This role consolidates the Model Serving and Runtime Reliability streams under a single leader. Were running a 7-day internal-only candidate window for a senior infra backfill (L5) and looking for a short-term rotation lead for model deploys (4	6 weeks). Details below.

Tom (CTO): Welcome Sana! This consolidation should help reduce handoff friction between serving and ops. We'll keep matrixed team owners but expect tighter SLA governance.

Sana Malik: Hi all  excited to join. My priority in week 1 is meeting war-room owners and reviewing the last 3 incident timelines. Happy to have quick syncs with anyone owning model rollout automation.

Raj (Eng Manager - Model Serving): For the backfill, we prefer internal candidates who know the rollout pipelines (argo/flux) and have on-call experience. If youre interested, please apply by Apr 14. We'll run hiring screens Apr 18 and aim to close by May 6.

Lina (Talent): Internal application: <https://company.internal/hiring/model-ops-l5>. Please attach one-line summary of your relevant on-call/incidence experience. I'll also schedule a hiring panel with Eng Platform + SRE + Product Ops.

Zoe (SRE): I'm happy to cover rotation lead for model deploys for 4 weeks starting June 2 if needed. I can also document the current deploy runbook this week.

Anita (People Ops Bot): Anita created calendar events: "Sana intro  all-hands" on June 3, and "Model Ops hiring panel" for Apr 20. Invitations sent to Model Serving, Runtime, SRE, and DevEx.

Alex (Head of Platform): Quick note on reporting: engineers will remain in their current squads; Sana will own cross-team OKRs for model availability and batch/predict latency. We'll publish a small org diagram and escalation matrix by Apr 12.

Maya (People Ops): Action items recap:
- Lina: open internal candidate window & application link (due Apr 14)
- Raj & Alex: hiring rubric + panel folks (by Apr 12)
- Zoe: provisional rotation lead (confirm by May 20)
- Sana: 1:1 office hours in week of June 6 (sign-up sheet to follow)
- People Ops: org diagram + escalation matrix (Apr 12)

If you plan to apply or want to nominate someone, DM Lina and ping me. Please react with :eyes: if you saw this.
